nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' holding the token name (NanaInu).
Public string state variable 'symbol' holding the token symbol (NINU).
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' (9).
Public uint256 state variable '_totalSupply' tracking minted supply.
Mapping(address => uint) 'balances' storing token balances; the central asset ledger mutated by transfer/transferFrom and by the constructor.
Nested mapping 'allowed' storing ERC20 allowances and mutated by approve/transferFrom.
Constructor: sets name/symbol/decimals/_totalSupply and mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
totalSupply() view: returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using an unguarded subtraction.
balanceOf(address) view: returns balances[tokenOwner].
allowance(address,address) view: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve(address,uint): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without any owner/allowance guard.
transfer(address,uint): moves balances[msg.sender] -> balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd.
transferFrom(address,address,uint): moves balances and decrements the spender allowance; the allowance is never actually checked against msg.sender's approval.
SafeMath safeAdd(uint,uint): c = a + b; require(c >= a).
SafeMath safeSub(uint,uint): require(b <= a); c = a - b.
SafeMath safeMul(uint,uint): c = a * b; require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath safeDiv(uint,uint): require(b > 0); c = a / b.
msg.sender used inside the constructor as the initial token recipient.
msg.sender used by approve() as the allowance owner key.
msg.sender used by transfer() as the debited balance holder.
msg.sender used by transferFrom() as the allowance spender key (never validated against an approval).
Unguarded arithmetic subtraction '_totalSupply - balances[address(0)]' in totalSupply (Solidity 0.5 wraps silently, no SafeMath used).
Arithmetic addition a + b with post-condition require(c >= a) inside safeAdd.
Arithmetic subtraction a - b with pre-condition require(b <= a) inside safeSub.
Arithmetic multiplication a * b with post-condition require(a == 0 || c / a == b) inside safeMul.
Arithmetic division a / b with pre-condition require(b > 0) inside safeDiv.

Parameter tokenOwner of allowance().
Parameter spender of allowance().
Parameter spender of approve().
Parameter tokens of approve().
Parameter to of transfer().
Parameter tokens of transfer().
Parameter from of transferFrom().
Parameter to of transferFrom().

Parameter a of safeAdd().
Parameter b of safeAdd().
Local variable c holding the safeAdd() result.

Parameter b of safeSub().
Local variable c holding the safeSub() result.

Parameter b of safeMul().
Local variable c holding the safeMul() result.

Parameter b of safeDiv().
Local variable c holding the safeDiv() result.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the token name state variable.
Constructor writes the token symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to 100000000000000000000.
Constructor credits the entire supply to balances[msg.sender].
msg.sender determines which balance entry the constructor mints to (privileged initialization).
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)] before subtracting.
totalSupply() performs the unguarded subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)], which can wrap in Solidity 0.5.
balanceOf() reads the balances mapping.
allowance() reads the allowed mapping.
approve() overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] with an arbitrary value.
approve() keys the allowance write on the caller-controlled msg.sender.
transfer() debits and credits entries of the balances ledger.
transfer() debits balances[msg.sender] with an unvalidated caller identity.
transferFrom() debits balances[from] and credits balances[to].
transferFrom() decrements allowed[from][msg.sender]; the allowance is never checked before spending.
transferFrom() uses the caller-controlled msg.sender as the spender allowance key.
transfer() calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer() calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom() calls safeSub twice (sender balance and allowance).
transferFrom() calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
safeAdd executes the checked addition a + b.
safeSub executes the guarded subtraction a - b.
safeMul executes the checked multiplication a * b.
safeDiv executes the guarded division a / b.
balanceOf() reads the balance of the tokenOwner parameter.
allowance() indexes allowed with the tokenOwner parameter.
allowance() indexes allowed with the spender parameter.
approve() writes the allowance for the spender parameter.
approve() stores the tokens parameter as the allowance amount.
transfer() credits the to parameter balance entry.
transfer() uses the tokens parameter as the transfer amount.
transferFrom() debits the from parameter balance entry.
transferFrom() credits the to parameter balance entry.
transferFrom() uses the tokens parameter as the allowance spending amount.
safeAdd consumes parameter a.
safeAdd consumes parameter b.
Parameter a is an operand of the safeAdd addition.
Parameter b is an operand of the safeAdd addition.
safeAdd stores the computed sum into local c before returning it.
safeSub consumes parameter a.
safeSub consumes parameter b.
Parameter a is an operand of the safeSub subtraction.
Parameter b is an operand and the guard boundary of the safeSub subtraction.
safeSub stores the computed difference into local c before returning it.
safeMul consumes parameter a.
safeMul consumes parameter b.
Parameter a is an operand of the safeMul multiplication.
Parameter b is an operand of the safeMul multiplication.
safeMul stores the computed product into local c before returning it.
safeDiv consumes parameter a.
safeDiv consumes parameter b.
Parameter a is the numerator of the safeDiv division.
Parameter b is the denominator / guard boundary of the safeDiv division.
safeDiv stores the computed quotient into local c before returning it.

normalization_plan.reason: The tokenOwner parameter is only an alias for the balanceOf() lookup key and carries no independent semantics.
The tokenOwner parameter is only an alias for the allowance() mapping key.
The spender parameter is only an alias for the second allowance() mapping key.
The spender parameter is only an alias for the approve() allowance key.
The tokens parameter is only the value written into the allowance by approve().
The to parameter is only the recipient key of the balance update in transfer().
The tokens parameter is the amount passed to safeSub/safeAdd inside transfer().
The from parameter is only the debited key used by transferFrom().
The to parameter is only the credited key used by transferFrom().
The tokens parameter is the amount passed to safeSub/safeAdd inside transferFrom().
Parameter a is a direct operand of the safeAdd addition operation.
Parameter b is a direct operand of the safeAdd addition operation.
Local c is only the transient return value holder inside safeAdd().
Parameter a is a direct operand of the safeSub subtraction operation.
Parameter b is a direct operand and the require guard of the safeSub subtraction.
Local c is only the transient return value holder inside safeSub().
Parameter a is a direct operand of the safeMul multiplication operation.
Parameter b is a direct operand of the safeMul multiplication operation.
Local c is only the transient return value holder inside safeMul().
Parameter a is the numerator operand of the safeDiv division operation.
Parameter b is the denominator operand and require guard of the safeDiv division.
Local c is only the transient return value holder inside safeDiv().
